physicalNotes: Radius 0.688 +/- 0.048 solar radii from Q1-Q17 DR25 KOI Table, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-1795 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/Kepler_KOI_docs.html): 478,642 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.768 +/- 0.024 solar masses from Q1-Q17 DR25 KOI Table, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-1795 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/Kepler_KOI_docs.html); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4500 +/- 123 K from Q1-Q17 DR25 KOI Table, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-1795 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/Kepler_KOI_docs.html). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.

sources.position: Gaia DR3 source 2100442009379544320 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0, from the archived row src/objects/kepler-1795/source/photometry/gaia-dr3-source.csv
sources.distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 2.2804 +/- 0.3995 mas (same row, RUWE 16.36): 438.52 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published
